exposure: induction of labour at 39, 40, and 41 weeks of gestation
induction of labour at 39 weeks of gestational age
cohort: 77,327 nulliparous women aged 35 to 50 years delivering a singleton infant
finding: Bringing forward the routine offer of induction of labour from the current recommendation of 41-42 weeks to 40 weeks of gestation in nulliparous women aged ≥35 years may reduce overall rates of perinatal death.
